interchanges.ramp_length_source: derived from OpenStreetMap geometry: summed node-to-node distance along this exit's motorway_link way(s), from the gore node where the ramp leaves the motorway to the nearest node where it ends (a public road -- trunk to residential, not a service or private way -- or a dead end, else a motorway merge). Per direction of travel: the gore nearest the exit's junction nodes whose first ramp edge runs that way. Starts at the OSM diverge, at or near the gore, so any deceleration lane before it is not included. Screened: under 300 ft or over 1.5 mi dropped, not clamped. Starts at the OSM diverge, at or near the gore, so any deceleration lane before it is not included. Screened: under 300 ft or over 1.5 mi dropped, not clamped. hpms_terrain.source: DERIVED, not read: Canada has no national inventory like HPMS, so the class is the terrain the leg's own grade profile spends the most miles in (the reroute-enrich rule: sustained grade of 5 percent, or 4 percent with 1,000 ft of relief within 5 miles, is mountain; 1.5 percent or 400 ft of relief is hills; else flat), mapped flat to level, hills to rolling and mountain to mountainous. It reads the same elevation as the grade, so it is no independent check on it.

hpms_terrain.name: level
hpms_terrain.source: DERIVED, not read: Canada has no national inventory like HPMS, so the class is the terrain the leg's own grade profile spends the most miles in (the reroute-enrich rule: sustained grade of 5 percent, or 4 percent with 1,000 ft of relief within 5 miles, is mountain; 1.5 percent or 400 ft of relief is hills; else flat), mapped flat to level, hills to rolling and mountain to mountainous. It reads the same elevation as the grade, so it is no independent check on it.

toll_events.source: Confederation Bridge: CAD 20.00 flat for any vehicle since 2025, collected leaving Prince Edward Island at the Borden-Carleton plaza, nothing charged going onto the island (confederationbridge.com tolls, read 2026-11-22); amount derived at 1.3978 CAD per USD, the rate the game uses for Canadian fines.
